pages.title: Why layers
pages.text: Changing what hand tools can do must $(l)not$() affect Create's machines. Hence three layers:$(br)\n$(li)$(l)L1 inherit$(): read Create's recipe types directly$(br)$(li)$(l)L2 filter$(): disable one recipe for one tool$(br)$(li)$(l)L3 exclusive$(): recipes only hand tools can read

pages.title: Writing an L2 filter
pages.text: Datapack:$(br)$(c)data/<namespace>/handmade/filter/<tool>.json$(br)\nKubeJS:$(br)$(c)HandMadeEvents.toolFilter(e => e.disable('mortar', 'create:milling/charcoal'))$(br)\n$(italic)Disabled recipes vanish from JEI too, so both stay consistent. $()

pages.title: Writing an L3 recipe
pages.text: Datapack $(c)data/<namespace>/recipes/*.json$(), with $(c)type$() set to one of:$(br)\n$(li)$(c)create_hand_made:tool_recipe$() (dispatched by the tool field)$(br)$(li)$(c)create_hand_made:stonecutting_recipe$()$(br)$(li)$(c)create_hand_made:bellows_recipe$()

pages.title: Full documentation
pages.text: The per-tool recipe source matrix lives in $(c)docs/TOOL_REFERENCE.md$(); the full field reference and KubeJS examples are in $(c)docs/RECIPE_API.md$().$(br)\n$(italic)Bellows has no L2 — it has no L1 candidates and matches by fan_type. $()
